data:
"Sage" is a versatile term that pops up in everything from your kitchen to high-end software and competitive gaming. Depending on what you\u2019re looking for, here\u2019s a breakdown:
 Gaming & Pop Culture
VALORANT Agent:
Sage is a popular "Sentinel" character hailing from China. She\u2019s famous for her healing orbs, defensive ice walls, and her ultimate ability to resurrect fallen teammates.
SAGE Engine:
Short for
Strategy Action Game Engine
, this was the powerhouse behind classic RTS games like
Command & Conquer: Generals
and
The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-earth
.
Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom:
The Sages are key elemental allies (like the Sage of Fire or Water) who provide Tulin, Yunobo, and others with special abilities to help Link.
 Tech & Business
Accounting & ERP Software:
Sage is a major multinational software company. Their tools are the gold standard for many businesses handling payroll, HR, and complex financial management.
AI Developer Solutions:
Sage recently launched a suite of AI developer tools, focusing on building "AI Agents" and automated workflows for finance and tax compliance.
SageMath:
A free, open-source mathematics software system that combines the power of many existing packages (like NumPy and SciPy) into a common Python-based interface.
 Nature & Language
The Herb:
A perennial evergreen shrub (
Salvia officinalis
) used in cooking\u2014essential for a good Thanksgiving stuffing\u2014and historically used in "smudging" rituals to clear energy.
The Definition:
As an adjective, it means possessing deep wisdom or sound judgment (e.g., "sage advice"). As a noun, it refers to a profoundly wise person or a mentor.
Are you looking for help with a specific Sage software build, or were you asking about the VALORANT agent's abilities?
